capabilities: show an end-of-file marker at the bottom of each note
count unique external URLs in the current file
count unique internal wiki-style links in the current file
customize colors for the stats, lines, and EOF text
toggle individual statistics on or off

summary: Adds an end-of-file marker and unique URL and internal link counts to the bottom of each note.
